主要内容: Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. issued a press release on March 30, 2016, announcing its financial results for the fourth quarter and year ended December 31, 2015. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing. The information disclosed in this report, including the press release, is not deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The report also includes a signature from Eric Skolnik, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, confirming the filing on March 30, 2016.
